svg.title: What if the receipt has no total?
svg.desc: The actual synthetic receipt shows one pack of drawing paper and one box of pencils. The space for the Total line is blank. Asked to answer MISSING when that line is absent, SmolVLM-256M-Instruct returned 1 in this CPU run.

g.text: What if the receipt has no total?
Copy the printed Total line. If it is absent, answer MISSING.
Synthetic receipt used in the run
